subjects.candidate_subject: Retain the stored continuation throughout a stack walk
subjects.baseline_subject: [GR-81123] Preserve pending initialization writes across control-flow merges
subjects.head: 6f55b27d87897825f2a53af3b0a5bdbd7650aef8

independence: Inspected exact diff, native implementation, StoredContinuation allocation/copy/GC behavior, and supplied JDK source before reading continuation-*.log. No other reviewer findings read; no subagents, CI, paid tools, source edits, mx builds or checkstyle runs.
reasoning: This is an internal Native Image continuation-walker invariant, not a public StackWalker promise or portable HotSpot concurrency guarantee. JDK Continuation.stackWalker documentation does not promise snapshots under concurrent resume. JDK wrapWalk mounting and native walking mechanisms differ.

JavaStackWalker.updateStackPointerForContinuation rebases start, end, and current SP by the address delta of one stored object. Substituting a differently sized snapshot invalidates that premise; retaining the original object solves this without introducing new pointers.

The spliterator stored field is a GC root. Frame advancement and pointer rebasing execute uninterruptibly; interruptible frame metadata lookup is followed by rebasing before further physical advancement. AOT metadata is explicitly guaranteed in this upstream path, so omitted fork runtime-compilation lifetime tethers are appropriate to current scope.

Capture is lazy on first physical advance, not at StackWalker creation. Resumption before capture can yield a null or different snapshot; this existing race and synchronization contract are not fixed or worsened. allocateToYield fills the object before publishing it; initializeForContinuation handles a null IP as unwalkable.

On exhausted continuation, initialized=false and stored=null reset snapshot state before parent traversal. This does not promise an atomic snapshot of an entire changing continuation hierarchy. Real nested non-virtual continuations are outside the virtual-thread-only entry assertion and were not used to validate parent transitions.

The committed regression exercises deep-to-shallow replacement; stable phase and WAITING checks coordinate the unmount. JDK PARKING state maps to RUNNABLE; PARKED maps to WAITING. Test failure cleanup lacks a finally block, a low-impact hygiene opportunity rather than a blocker.
Independent comparisons check complete method-name sequences, nested fresh walkers, repeated replacement, completion, and allocation plus explicit GC after every frame.
